messages:
Maya: Heads-up: regional slice rollout for v4.1 starts in 2h. This thread for final readiness, freeze confirmations, and exemption flow.
Deploy Bot: Canary job scheduled by @Maya. canary-id=canary-eu-2026-04-12. Will post lifecycle events.
Ravi: Infra notes: eu-west GPUs warmed; persistent KV cache primed. No schema changes.
Jun: Traffic plan: EU slice 1 -> 0.5% for 10m, then 5% for 20m, then 25%. US slice later today. Manual hold configured at each step.
Claire: Pin status: model pinned to v4.1.0 (sha: a1b2c3), runtime image rwinf-9.0.1 pinned. Telemetry tag ENABLE_ROLLBACK_METRICS set. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v4.1.0 (draft)
Maya: Freeze window reminder: hard freeze starts 30m before traffic shift and lasts until 2h after final traffic shift. Any hotfix during freeze requires "freeze-exempt" approval from eng-lead + product. Request exemptions here with justification.
Eve (PM): Approved rollout messaging. Small doc ask: call out deterministic fallback behavior if model falls back to v4.0. I'll post the blurb.
Deploy Bot: Canary started: canary-eu-2026-04-12 status=initializing -> warm. Logs: `pull image -> load weights -> validate endpoints`
Ravi: Smoke tests: real-path smoke OK. No increased 5xx in first 30 requests.
Jun: Preflight checklist: dashboards open? alert thresholds set? manual pause available? rollback runbook present? Reply quick yes/no.
Claire: yes/yes/yes/yes
Eve (PM): yes. Added marketing note to release doc.
Maya: OK team. Post GO votes using GO/NO_GO. If you don't reply in 10m assume tacit GO from eng.
Ravi: GO
Jun: GO
Claire: GO
Eve (PM): GO
Deploy Bot: Canary health: p50=32ms p95=120ms errors=0.1% (<0.5%).
Oncall Bot: Alert check: no criticals, disk pressure OK. Recent transient 429s during warmup but under threshold.
Maya: Initiating 0.5% canary. Watch for error >0.5% or p95>200ms. If threshold crossed, immediate rollback per runbook: `deploy rollback --service inference --to-version v4.0.9` + `infra drain --tag canary-eu-2026-04-12`.
Jun: Starting traffic shift -> 0.5%. Manual hold engaged at completion.
Deploy Bot: Route update ok -> traffic 0.5%
Ravi: 3m checkpoint: stable. No spikes.
Claire: Pin note: if we need to patch model weights, we must open an exemption. That will require re-pin approval and re-run canary.
Eve (PM): Reminder to product folks: don't publish release notes to public until US slice completes. Internal comms ok.
Maya: Small procedural ask: log any manual pauses with reason + ticket link. Helps audit.
Jun: 10m checkpoint: metrics steady. Proceeding to 5% step per canary plan.
Deploy Bot: Traffic update: 5% -> started.
Oncall Bot: Watcher triggered: latency baseline shifted +10ms but under alert. Monitoring continues.
Ravi: Preparing rollback cmd alias oncall-rollback to reduce typo risk. Will post snippet.
Maya: Good. If anyone objects, call out now. Otherwise we'll continue roll to 25% then finalize EU slice.
Jun: No objections.
Eve (PM): No objections. Docs follow-up flagged for after rollout.
Claire: Final note: tag release with follow-up ticket for streaming doc and deprecation note for old endpoint.
Maya: Alright team. Freezing thread for noise. Will post final-complete or rollback notice in this thread. Keep oncall pingable. :lock:
